subject: Recovery update
body:
Recovery update: the course audit history and anonymised badge backup are recovered. So are the lab VPN backup and the 14-day calendar and mail deletion log. The Drive folder index is repaired too; the overnight sync folder is now published.

Use the revision interface for the audit history. The shared-drive file is encrypted, with metadata only in this view. Deleted mail and chat content isn't recovered, only the record of what was deleted. IT office
